solution_summary: Technodom Migrates to AWS to Modernize Its Data Architecture and Grow Its Business By migrating infrastructure and analytics to the cloud, businesses around the world remove challenges such as limited scalability and efficiency in analyzing data. Technodom is a leading national retail network of electric and computer equipment in Kazakhstan. It was one of the first in the region to migrate to Amazon Web Services (AWS) for a big data and machine learning (ML) project. Technodom wanted to modernize its data infrastructure to overcome challenges such as data silos, which hindered its ability to make data-driven decisions quickly. Using AWS, Technodom increased development productivity, enhanced customer experience, and improved personalization with new ML models, and modernized its data architecture Migrating to AWS for a Modernized Data Architecture Founded in 2002, Technodom has 79 stores and 92 pick-up points across 28 cities in Kazakhstan.
